sections.title: Installer-led, *since day one*

image.alt: A living room with built-in shelves around the fireplace

body: Dynamic Audio & Video is a family-owned business. Dave worked as an electronic technician for 13 years, wiring churches for sound, and found his passion installing his first home theaters.

In 2000 he became a lead installer for a custom audio-video retailer, then a project manager running installations across New Jersey, New York City and Connecticut. He built Dynamic Audio & Video around what people wanted most, the highest-quality installations and real customer service, and in 2021 he brought it to Aiken.

items.text: The movie experience feels as good as any theater one might visit and the sound system is simply wonderful.
Your installation was done on time, on budget and looked great. I really appreciated how accessible you are when we have questions, you always call back very promptly.
It took the hassle and frustration of trying to figure out how to use 4 different remotes and made it simple with just one remote.

items.q: Do I have to buy my equipment from you?
items.a: No. Whether you buy your equipment on your own or from us, we will work with you every step of the way. You won’t be pressured to buy anything.

items.q: Can you work with equipment I already own?
items.a: Yes. We install and service pre-owned equipment.
Yes: pre-construction consultation, structured wiring, and satellite, cable, phone and data wiring.
Our service doesn’t stop when the installation is complete. Our trained technicians are available to take care of your needs.
